source_excerpts.text:
## 1. The theorem

Let a fixed \(d\)-dimensional system evolve under

\[
\mathcal L(\rho)
=
-i[H,\rho]
+
\sum_a
\left(
L_a\rho L_a^\dagger
-\frac12\{L_a^\dagger L_a,\rho\}
\right).
\]

Write

\[
\mathcal N_t=e^{t\mathcal L},
\qquad
\mathcal B_t=\mathcal N_t^c.
\]

Here \(\mathcal B_t\) is the **full pure-environment complementary channel**:

- Alice prepares the source input and may retain a reference.
- Bob receives the complete coherent environmental output.
- The residual source system is discarded.
- Each use starts with a fresh environment.
- Local quantum operations and two-way classical communication are available.
- No initial shared entanglement is supplied.

Let \(Q_{\leftrightarrow}(\mathcal B_t)\) denote its two-way assisted quantum capacity, measured in qubits per fresh use. Use a canonical traceless Lindblad family, with its associated Hamiltonian.

Then, as \(t\downarrow0\),

| Finite generator condition | Optimal communication order |
|---|---:|
| The noise operators fail simultaneous unitary diagonalization | \(\Theta_{\mathcal L}(t)\) |
| The noise operators commute and are normal, but \([H,L_a]\neq0\) for some \(a\) | \(\Theta_{\mathcal L}\!\bigl(t^3\log(1/t)\bigr)\) |
| The noise operators commute and are normal, and \([H,L_a]=0\) for every \(a\) | \(0\) for every \(t\) |

Simultaneous unitary diagonalization is equivalent to the family consisting of pairwise commuting normal matrices. The zero case includes purely Hamiltonian evolution.

**These three alternatives exhaust the stated class.** The generator and dimension remain fixed as \(t\) decreases. Constants can become poor near a class boundary. A fixed time unit makes the logarithm dimensionless.

For rational-complex or algebraic matrix descriptions, finite exact commutator tests determine the branch. This is not an exact-zero decision procedure for arbitrary computable real coefficients, and it is not a finite-data identification theorem.

There is also an all-time consequence. For \(0<s<t\), the early environment is an output degradation of the complete later environment:

\[
\mathcal B_s=\mathcal D_{s,t}\circ\mathcal B_t.
\]

Consequently,

\[
Q_{\leftrightarrow}(\mathcal B_s)
\le
Q_{\leftrightarrow}(\mathcal B_t).
\]

Every positive-onset branch therefore has positive assisted capacity at every positive time. The common-diagonal branch is the only zero branch. This decides zero

## 7. The linear and zero branches also close constructively

When the noise family is not commuting and normal, a nonnormal direction is found in the finite list

\[
L_a,\qquad
\frac{L_a+L_b}{\sqrt2},\qquad
\frac{L_a+iL_b}{\sqrt2}.
\]

For a selected nonnormal \(L\),

\[
L^\dagger L-LL^\dagger
\]

is nonzero, Hermitian and traceless. A negative eigenvector supplies an explicit two-dimensional extraction space.

Coherent vacuum attenuation and jump selection succeed with probability \(\Theta(t)\), producing a two-qubit state with a fixed strict entanglement margin. Explicit local filtering, finitely many recurrence rounds and an acquired efficient code yield a positive constant conditional rate. Hence the total rate is \(\Omega(t)\).

A separate adaptive converse proves

\[
\|T\circ\mathcal B_t\|_\diamond\le1+O(t),
\]

and therefore

\[
Q_{\leftrightarrow}(\mathcal B_t)=O(t).
\]

The manuscript gives the partial-transpose bookkeeping and the adaptive argument directly. Transposition bounds for LOCC-assisted capacity are established machinery. [arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/html/1502.05630v2?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

In the zero branch, all \(H,L_a\) share a pointer basis. The dilation has the form

\[
|i\rangle\longmapsto
e^{i\theta_i(t)}|i\rangle|\eta_i(t)\rangle.
\]

Discarding the source gives

\[
\mathcal B_t(\rho)
=
\sum_i\rho_{ii}|\eta_i(t)\rangle\langle\eta_i(t)|.
\]

This is measure and prepare, so its quantum capacity remains zero even with two-way classical assistance.

The qualitative low-rank PPT/separability and NPT/one-copy-distillability results underlying this area are already established. Chen–Djokovic also use the \(1,i\) combination argument. Those mechanisms are credited as precedents, not promoted as new discoveries here. [arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1101.5134v4?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## 2. What this establishes beyond ordinary routing and entanglement processing

The consequential claim is the **matched operational law for an entire class of physical dynamics**.

Given the exact finite generator and the stipulated coherent interface, one can now:

1. Determine whether the environment can transmit quantum information.
2. Determine the optimal short-time order, including the logarithmic factor.
3. Acquire a finite receiver instrument exposing the useful quantum component.
4. Construct Bell-pair distribution and subsequent transmission of fresh unknown payloads.
5. Account for failed attempts, memory, coherent waiting, decoding, precision and code acquisition.

The upper bounds already allow arbitrary block encodings, adaptive feedback, entanglement concentration and error correction. They are comparisons against the strongest protocols under the same interface.

A direct swap, delivery of the surviving source system, or a separate erasure link changes that interface. Those may be better engineering choices where available. The theorem concerns a fixed source whose environmental output is the available communication link.

Several ingredients are established. Leung and Watrous already proved positive unassisted complementary capacity for nontrivial qubit depolarizing channels and extended their argument to relevant Pauli channels. Siddhu developed entropy-singularity methods giving broader complementary-capacity positivity results. Thus neither complementary-channel positivity nor the appearance of a logarithmic entropy term is the new claim. [arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/html/1510.01366v4?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

The proposed advance is the **universal zero/linear/cubic-log classification, with matching adaptive converses and acquired constructions**. Established entanglement protocols remain the machinery that completes transmission.
